English Language Requirement: Students whose home institution teaches and assesses all subjects in English may satisfy the English requirement through their previous study. Course Selection: Undergraduate or graduate-level subjects may be taken depending on the student’s home degree and academic background. Individual subjects may have prerequisites or faculty-specific restrictions. school_name: 九州大學 Kyushu University
degrees_raw: 學士班, 碩士班, 博士班
note_9358: 秋季班：10-2月春季班：4月-8月 https://www.isc.kyushu-u.ac.jp/intlweb/en/admission/exchangetop?utm_source=chatgpt.com 申請資格： 申請者於交換開始時須已在母校學位課程修讀至少 1 年 ，並應申請與目前就讀學位層級相同之課程；申請研究所交換者須具備大學畢業證書或學位證明。 GPA 要求： 最低 3.2/4.0 。 語言要求： 日語授課課程： JLPT N1 或同等程度 。 英語授課課程： TOEFL iBT 79／IELTS 6.0 或同等程度 。 英語能力亦可提供九州大學認可之其他同等證明； TOEIC 不接受 。 大學部／研究所交換： 可申請九州大學相關 School／Graduate School 。大學部學生不得修習研究所層級課程；研究所各研究科可使用日語或英語進行交換，實際課程及研究安排依各研究科規定為準。 JTW (Japan in Today’s World)： 主要為 大學部學生 設計， 研究生亦可申請 ，惟大學部學生於錄取時享有優先；最低 GPA 3.2/4.0 ，英語須達 TOEFL iBT 79／IELTS 6.0 或同等程度 。 JLCC (Japanese Language and Culture Courses)： 限母校主修 Japanese Studies（日語／日本研究）之大學部學生 申請；最低 GPA 3.2/4.0 ；原則須具備 JLPT N1 ， JLPT N2 亦可接受 。僅於秋季開始，交換期間為 1 學年（10月–8月） 。 詳細資訊： Kyushu University – Exchange Programs Fact Sheet： Kyushu University – Fact Sheet June 2026 Eligibility: Applicants must have completed at least one year of study in a degree programme at their home university by the time of enrolment and should apply for a programme at the same academic level as their current enrolment. An undergraduate diploma or certificate of graduation is required for nomination to a graduate programme. GPA Requirement: Minimum 3.2/4.0 . Language Requirement: Japanese-taught courses: JLPT N1 or equivalent . English-taught courses: TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.0 or equivalent . Other equivalent qualifications accepted by Kyushu University may also be submitted as proof of English proficiency. TOEIC is not accepted . Undergraduate / Graduate Exchange: Students may apply to the relevant School or Graduate School at Kyushu University. Undergraduate students are not permitted to enrol in graduate-level courses. Graduate programmes may be conducted in Japanese or English, subject to the requirements and course/research availability of the respective Graduate School. JTW (Japan in Today’s World): Primarily designed for undergraduate students . Postgraduate students may also apply ; however, undergraduate students are given priority in admission. Minimum GPA 3.2/4.0 ; TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.0 or equivalent is required. JLCC (Japanese Language and Culture Courses): Open to undergraduate students majoring in Japanese Studies at their home institution. Minimum GPA 3.2/4.0 ; JLPT N1 is generally required, although JLPT N2 is acceptable . The programme starts in the fall semester only and runs for one academic year (October–August) . More Information: Kyushu University – Exchange Programs Fact Sheet： Kyushu University – Fact Sheet June 2026

note_9358: 秋季班：10-2月春季班：4月-8月 https://www.insc.tohoku.ac.jp/english/exchange/english-requirement-for-exchange-program/?utm_source=chatgpt.com 交換計畫： JYPE (Junior Year Program in English)： 限大學部 3、4 年級 學生；適用 理學、工學及農學 領域，以 英語授課 ；可交換秋季 1 學期 或自秋季起交換 1 學年 。 IPLA (International Program in Liberal Arts)： 限大學部 2–4 年級 學生；適用 人文及社會科學 領域。可交換 1 學期或 1 學年 ；春季入學僅限指定姊妹校學生申請。 DEEP (Direct Enrollment Education Program)： 限 大學部學生 ；適用 理學、醫學、牙醫、藥學、工學及農學 等自然科學相關領域，課程主要以 日語授課 。 COLABS (Cooperative Laboratory Study Program)： 限 研究所學生 ，為以 自然科學領域研究 為主之研究型交換計畫。 語言要求： JYPE／IPLA／COLABS： TOEFL iBT 79 、TOEFL PBT 550 、IELTS 6.0 、TOEIC 730 、CEFR B2 或其他同等英語能力證明。 DEEP： JLPT N1 或同等程度 。 COLABS 特別注意： 申請者須事先取得東北大學預定指導教授之同意。自 2026 秋季 起，須依東北大學規定之時程，透過 Prior Consent of Acceptance Request 程序提出申請；申請者 不得自行直接聯絡預定指導教授 。 詳細資訊： Tohoku University – Exchange Programs Fact Sheet： Tohoku University – Fact Sheet Exchange Programmes: JYPE (Junior Year Program in English): For 3rd- and 4th-year undergraduate students in Science, Engineering, and Agriculture ; taught in English . Available for one fall semester or one academic year starting in the fall semester . IPLA (International Program in Liberal Arts): For 2nd- to 4th-year undergraduate students in Humanities and Social Sciences . Available for one semester or one academic year . Spring admission is available only to students from designated partner universities. DEEP (Direct Enrollment Education Program): For undergraduate students in Science, Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, and Agriculture ; courses are primarily taught in Japanese . COLABS (Cooperative Laboratory Study Program): A graduate-level, research-oriented programme in the Natural Sciences . Language Requirements: JYPE / IPLA / COLABS: TOEFL iBT 79 , TOEFL PBT 550 , IELTS 6.0 , TOEIC 730 , CEFR B2 , or equivalent. DEEP: JLPT N1 or equivalent . COLABS: Applicants must obtain prior consent from a prospective academic advisor through Tohoku University's official Prior Consent of Acceptance Request procedure. Applicants must not contact prospective academic advisors directly . More Information: Tohoku University – Exchange Programs Fact Sheet： Tohoku University – Fact Sheet

Only master's and d octoral students from the Colleges of Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, Nuclear Science, and the College of Semiconductor Research are eligible. note_9358: 秋季班：10-2月春季班：4月-8月 h ttps://www.global.hokudai.ac.jp/admissions/short-term-exchange/ HUSTEP（Hokkaido University Short-Term Exchange Program）： 限 大學部學生 申請，且抵達北海道大學前須已完成至少 2年大學課程 。 課程主要以 英語授課 ，不要求具備日語能力。 GPA：原則為累積 GPA 3.0/4.0以上或同等程度（or equivalent）。 GPA 將於正式申請後，由北海道大學依申請人原就讀大學之 成績評分制度（grading policy）進行換算及審查 。因此，若原學校採不同 GPA 制度（如本校採4.3制），無法直接以原校 GPA 判定是否等同 3.0/4.0， 實際換算及資格認定以北海道大學審查結果為準 。 北海道大學另說明， 審查並非僅以 GPA 為唯一標準 ，亦會綜合考量 英語能力、推薦信、申請動機（Motivation Letter）等資料 ；因此，並非只有 GPA 已確認達 3.0/4.0以上者才能提出申請。 非英語母語者須具備 TOEFL iBT 79 或 IELTS 6.5以上 ；其他國際認可英語檢定（如 CEFR C1以上 ）亦可能接受， 不接受 TOEIC 或 Duolingo 。北海道大學並公告，自 2028年1月起 採用新版 TOEFL iBT 分數時，最低要求為 4.5 。 可交換 一學期 或一學年 HUSTEP 學生 有資格申請 JASSO 獎學金，但名額有限，並非所有學生皆可獲得 。 Special Auditor（Undergraduate）： 限 大學部學生 ，分配至特定學院，與一般學位生共同修習所屬專業領域課程；北海道大學註明，專業科目可提供給 大二以上 大學生。 須具備良好學業成績，以及相當於 JLPT N2以上 之日語能力（preferably native level）。 可交換 一學期 或一學年 獎學金：N/A 。 Special Auditor（Graduate）： 限 研究生 ，分配至特定研究所／學院，修習其專業領域課程。 須具備良好學業成績；原則上須具備相當於 JLPT N2以上 之日語能力，但 實際要求依各研究所而異 。 可交換 一學期 或一學年 獎學金：N/A 。 Special Research Student（SRS）： 限 研究生 ，分配至特定研究所，以專業領域之 研究及接受研究指導 為主，而非一般修課型交換。 須具備良好學業成績，以及足以與指導教授溝通之 英語或日語能力 ；實際要求可能依研究所或指導教授而異。 原則上申請前須先聯繫教授，取得願意提供研究指導的 非正式同意（unofficial agreement） ；部分學院不要求此程序，應依申請時規定確認。 可交換 一學期 或一學年 不授予學分 ，SRS 學生僅接受研究指導； 獎學金：N/A 。 在學身分： Special Auditor 及 SRS 交換期間均須持續以 全職學生身分註冊於原就讀大學 。 詳細資訊： Hokkaido University – HUSTEP Hokkaido University – Special Auditor / Special Research Student Fact Sheet： Hokkaido University - Fact Sheet 2026-2027 HUSTEP (Hokkaido University Short-Term Exchange Program) Eligibility: Undergraduate students only; applicants must have completed at least two years of undergraduate study prior to arrival. Courses: Mainly taught in English . Japanese proficiency is not required . GPA: A cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, or equivalent , is required. If the home university uses a different GPA scale (e.g. NTHU’s 4.3 scale ), eligibility will be determined by Hokkaido University based on its assessment . English Requirement: TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5 or above . Other internationally recognised English qualifications, such as CEFR C1 or above , may also be accepted. TOEIC and Duolingo are not accepted. New TOEFL iBT Scale: From January 2028 , the minimum requirement will be 4.5 . Exchange Period: One semester or one academic year . Scholarship: Students may apply for the JASSO Scholarship , subject to availability. Special Auditor (Undergraduate) Eligibility: Undergraduate students who wish to take courses in their specialised field. Specialised courses are generally available from the second year onwards . Academic Requirement: Strong academic record. Japanese Requirement: JLPT N2 or equivalent or above ; a higher level of Japanese proficiency is recommended. Exchange Period: One semester or one academic year . Special Auditor (Graduate) Eligibility: Graduate students who wish to take courses in their specialised field. Academic Requirement: Strong academic record. Japanese Requirement: In principle, JLPT N2 or equivalent or above . Requirements may vary by Graduate School. Exchange Period: One semester or one academic year . Special Research Student (SRS) Eligibility: Graduate students undertaking research in their specialised field under academic supervision . Academic Requirement: Strong academic record. Language Requirement: Sufficient English or Japanese proficiency to communicate with the academic supervisor. Requirements may vary by Graduate School or supervisor. Prospective Supervisor: Applicants generally need to contact a prospective supervisor and obtain an unofficial agreement before applying ; however, this may not be required by some faculties. Credits: No credits are awarded to SRS students. Exchange Period: One semester or one academic year . More Info： Hokkaido University – HUSTEP Hokkaido University – Special Auditor / Special Research Student Fact Sheet： Hokkaido University - Fact Sheet 2026-2027
vm_note: HUSTEP（Hokkaido University Short-Term Exchange Program）： 限 大學部學生 申請，且抵達北海道大學前須已完成至少 2年大學課程 。 課程主要以 英語授課 ，不要求具備日語能力。 累積 GPA 須達 3.0/4.0以上或同等程度（or equivalent） 。若原學校採不同 GPA 制度（如本校採4.3制），實際資格認定依北海道大學審查結果為準。 非英語母語者須具備 TOEFL iBT 79 或 IELTS 6.5以上 ；其他國際認可英語檢定（如 CEFR C1以上 ）亦可能接受， 不接受 TOEIC 或 Duolingo 。北海道大學並公告，自 2028年1月起 採用新版 TOEFL iBT 分數時，最低要求為 4.5 。 可交換 一學期 或一學年 HUSTEP 學生 有資格申請 JASSO 獎學金，但名額有限，並非所有學生皆可獲得 。 Special Auditor（Undergraduate）： 限 大學部學生 ，分配至特定學院，與一般學位生共同修習所屬專業領域課程；北海道大學註明，專業科目可提供給 大二以上 大學生。 須具備良好學業成績，以及相當於 JLPT N2以上 之日語能力（preferably native level）。 可交換 一學期 或一學年 獎學金：N/A 。 Special Auditor（Graduate）： 限 研究生 ，分配至特定研究所／學院，修習其專業領域課程。 須具備良好學業成績；原則上須具備相當於 JLPT N2以上 之日語能力，但 實際要求依各研究所而異 。 可交換 一學期 或一學年 獎學金：N/A 。 Special Research Student（SRS）： 限 研究生 ，分配至特定研究所，以專業領域之 研究及接受研究指導 為主，而非一般修課型交換。 須具備良好學業成績，以及足以與指導教授溝通之 英語或日語能力 ；實際要求可能依研究所或指導教授而異。 原則上申請前須先聯繫教授，取得願意提供研究指導的 非正式同意（unofficial agreement） ；部分學院不要求此程序，應依申請時規定確認。 可交換 一學期 或一學年 不授予學分 ，SRS 學生僅接受研究指導； 獎學金：N/A 。 在學身分： Special Auditor 及 SRS 交換期間均須持續以 全職學生身分註冊於原就讀大學 。 詳細資訊： Hokkaido University – HUSTEP Hokkaido University – Special Auditor / Special Research Student

note_9358: 秋季班：10-2月春季班：4月-8月 https://www.kanazawa-u.ac.jp/en/global-network/study/kuep/?utm_source=chatgpt.com 學業要求： 須具 優良學業表現（excellent academic performance） ，原則上成績達 母校平均水準以上(above average) 。經金澤大學確認， 無明確最低 GPA 門檻 ，由本校依自身標準進行甄選及提名；符合本校交換生甄選資格者，可依本校程序提出申請。 JASSO 獎學金： 另有學業成績相關資格要求，並依其他條件綜合評選， 符合學業要求不代表一定獲獎 。 年級限制： 申請 融合科學院、理工學院、醫藥保健學院 之大學部學生，交換開始前須已在母校就讀至少 3年（或5學期） 。 語言要求： 日語授課課程：JLPT N2以上 。 人文社會環境研究科「日本語教育」專業：JLPT N1 。 英語授課課程：TOEIC L&R 700 / TOEFL iBT 72（2026年1月起應試者：新制4.0）/ TOEFL PBT 527 / IELTS 5.5 / Cambridge English 160以上 。 特定學院／研究所要求： 申請 理工學院、醫藥保健學院，以及部分自然科學、醫學相關研究所 者，須就讀母校相對應領域之系所，並具備參與專業研究所需之能力與知識。 指導教授事前同意： 申請 融合科學院、理工學院、醫藥保健學院或研究所 者，須於申請前取得欲申請之指導教授的 事前同意（Provisional Acceptance） ；申請 人文社會學院 者則不需要。 其他： 交換結束後須返回母校繼續就讀；交換期間須維持母校正式學生身分。 詳細資訊： Kanazawa University – KUEP Fact Sheet： Kanazawa University – Fact Sheet-2027-2028 Academic Requirement: Applicants must demonstrate excellent academic performance , in principle above the average of their home institution . Kanazawa University has confirmed that there is no specific minimum GPA requirement ; NTHU may select and nominate students based on its own academic criteria. JASSO Scholarship: Separate academic eligibility requirements apply, and meeting them does not guarantee a scholarship award . Year of Study Requirement: Undergraduate applicants to the College of Transdisciplinary Sciences for Innovation, College of Science and Engineering, or College of Medical, Pharmaceutical and Health Sciences must have been enrolled at their home institution for at least three years (or five semesters) before the program begins. Language Requirements: Japanese-taught courses: JLPT N2 or above. Japanese Language Education in the Graduate School of Human and Socio-Environment Studies: JLPT N1. English-taught courses: TOEIC L&R 700 / TOEFL iBT 72 (4.0 on the new scale for tests taken from January 2026) / TOEFL PBT 527 / IELTS 5.5 / Cambridge English 160 or above. Requirements for Specific Colleges / Graduate Schools: Applicants to the College of Science and Engineering, College of Medical, Pharmaceutical and Health Sciences, and designated natural science and medical graduate schools must be enrolled in a corresponding field at their home institution and possess the ability and knowledge required to participate in specialised research. Prior Approval from an Academic Supervisor: Applicants to the College of Transdisciplinary Sciences for Innovation, College of Science and Engineering, College of Medical, Pharmaceutical and Health Sciences, or a Graduate School must obtain prior approval (Provisional Acceptance) from their prospective academic supervisor before applying . Applicants to the College of Human and Social Sciences are not required to obtain such approval. Other Requirements: Students must return to their home institution to resume their studies after completing the exchange and must maintain their regular student status at their home institution. More Information: Kanazawa University – KUEP Fact Sheet： Kanazawa University – Fact Sheet-2027-2028

school_name: 漢陽大學 Hanyang University
degrees_raw: 學士班, 碩士班, 博士班
note_9358: 秋季班: 9-12月 春季班:3-6月 交換校區：Seoul Campus。 課程： 提供一般課程及 英語授課課程 。交換生可視課程開放情形跨系選課；最新課程通常於開學前約 1 個月公布。 研究生申請： Seoul Campus 原則上 不接受交換生進入 Graduate Program 。研究生仍可參加交換，但須修讀 Undergraduate Program 課程；與漢陽大學 Graduate School 有直接合作協議者除外。 不開放院系（Seoul Campus）： College of Medicine、College of Technology Innovation、Department of Data Science、Department of Semiconductor Engineering、Hanyang YK Intercollege。 School of Nursing 及 Graduate School（所有系所）僅限具系級交換協議者申請。 語言要求： 韓語 TOPIK 3級 ；或英語 IELTS 5.5 / TOEIC 785 / TOEFL iBT 72（新制 4.0）/ TOEFL ITP 543 。 選課提醒： Business School 課程需求較高， 無法保證選到欲修課程 ；College of Art and Physical Education、College of Music 的英語授課課程較少，College of Education 部分課程亦有限制。 詳細資訊： Hanyang University – Inbound Exchange Program Fact Sheet： Hanyang University – Fact Sheet AY 2026/2027 Exchange Campus: Seoul Campus. Courses: Regular and English-taught courses are available. Exchange students may take courses across different departments subject to availability. The most up-to-date course list is generally available approximately one month before the semester begins. Graduate Students: The Seoul Campus generally does not accept exchange students into Graduate Programs . Graduate students may participate in the exchange programme but are required to take undergraduate-level courses. Exceptions apply to universities with direct partnerships with Hanyang University's Graduate Schools. Colleges/Schools Not Available (Seoul Campus): College of Medicine, College of Technology Innovation, Department of Data Science, Department of Semiconductor Engineering, and Hanyang YK Intercollege. School of Nursing and Graduate School (all departments) are available only under a department-level agreement. Language Requirements: Korean: TOPIK Level 3 ; or English: IELTS 5.5 / TOEIC 785 / TOEFL iBT 72 (new scale 4.0) / TOEFL ITP 543 . Course Registration: Courses in the Business School are in particularly high demand and registration is not guaranteed . English-taught courses are limited in the College of Art and Physical Education and the College of Music, while some courses in the College of Education are also restricted. More Information: Hanyang University – Inbound Exchange Program Fact Sheet： Hanyang University – Fact Sheet AY 2026/2027

note_9358: 秋季班：9-12月 春季班：3月-6月 建議語言能力（符合以下任一即可）： 英語： TOEFL iBT 88 （新制 4.5 ）或 IELTS 6.0 以上。 韓語： TOPIK 5 級 以上。 韓國歷史系、心理學系、統計學系、藥學系 須提供韓語能力證明，並達 TOPIK 5 級以上 。 科系限制： 商學院： 限原校主修 商學或經濟學 之學生。 電腦科學與工程系： 大學部申請者須已修至少 15 學分 CSE 相關課程 。 **醫學院：** 不開放交換生 。 牙醫學院： 僅開放牙醫相關 碩士班學生 。 MBA： 僅 春季班 開放，且限原校 全日制 MBA 學生 。 法學院： 一般大學部交換生不可直接申請大學部法學課程，部分 School of Law 課程得以研究生身分修習。 聲樂系： 限原校主修聲樂之學生。 特定領域： 欲申請 Medicine、Pharmacy、Dentistry、Nursing、Music、Fine Arts、MBA 者，須事先向 SNU 交換計畫承辦人確認是否開放。 詳細資訊： Seoul National University – Exchange Program Fact Sheet： Seoul National University – Fact Sheet Recommended Language Proficiency (either English or Korean): English: TOEFL iBT 88 (new scale: 4.5 ) or IELTS 6.0 or above. Korean: TOPIK Level 5 or above. Departments of Korean History, Psychology, Statistics, and Pharmacy: Applicants must provide proof of Korean proficiency at TOPIK Level 5 or above . Academic Restrictions: College of Business Administration: Restricted to students currently majoring in Business or Economics at their home university. Department of Computer Science and Engineering: Undergraduate applicants must have completed at least 15 credits of CSE-related courses . College of Medicine: Not open to exchange students . School of Dentistry: Open only to Master’s students in Dentistry or an equivalent programme . MBA: Available in the Spring semester only and restricted to full-time MBA students . College of Law: Not open to undergraduate exchange students; certain School of Law courses may be available under graduate-level enrolment arrangements. Department of Vocal Music: Restricted to students currently majoring in Vocal Music . Special Programme Restrictions: Applicants interested in Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry, Nursing, Music, Fine Arts, or MBA must confirm programme availability with the SNU exchange programme coordinator in advance. More Information: Seoul National University – Exchange Program Fact Sheet： Seoul National University – Fact Sheet

note_9358: 秋季班: 8-12月 春季班:1-5月 僅接受碩士班學生申請 。 成績要求： 在學成績 GPA 達 4.00 。 相關費用： 須繳交 簽證手續費 US$450 及 訪問學生費 US$500 。 系所限制： Physics Department、School of Law、School of Journalism 及 School of Business 等系所 錄取難度較高 。 註冊及成績單： 交換生無法正式註冊或取得正式成績單，僅可開立 上課證明 ；如需正式註冊及取得成績／學分，須另繳學費或學分費（ 每學分 US$700 ）。 指導教授： 學生通過本校甄選後，須 自行聯繫 UC Berkeley 指導教授 ，並取得教授同意接收後，始可進行後續交換申請。建議於校內申請前先行聯繫可能的指導教授。 選填建議： 建議以 工學院、電資院等相關領域碩士生 為主，且建議交流期間至少 1 年 。由於該校拒絕學生之比例較高，請同學選填前審慎評估。 Eligibility: Master’s students only. GPA Requirement: Minimum GPA of 4.00 . Fees: A US$450 visa processing fee and a US$500 visiting student fee are required. Departmental Restrictions: The Department of Physics and the Schools of Law, Journalism, and Business are among the most difficult programmes for acceptance. Registration & Transcript: Exchange students cannot formally register or receive an official transcript and may only obtain a certificate of attendance . Formal registration/credits require additional tuition or credit fees ( US$700 per credit ). Faculty Supervisor: After passing NTHU’s internal selection, students must find and obtain approval from a UC Berkeley faculty supervisor before proceeding with the exchange application. Students are strongly advised to contact potential supervisors before applying through NTHU. Recommendation: This exchange is primarily recommended for Master’s students in engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, and related fields . A stay of at least one year is recommended. As the rejection rate is relatively high, students should carefully consider their suitability before selecting UC Berkeley.

note_9358: 秋季班: 8-12月 春季班:1-5月 https://studyabroad.illinois.edu/incoming-students/incoming-application-process/instructions-components/?utm_source=chatgpt.com 院系限制 ：限申請 College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (LAS) 。 研究生身分： 碩、博士生赴 UIUC 交換時將以 大學部學生身分註冊 ，但可修習高年級大學部及研究所課程。 建議英語能力： Duolingo English Test： 130 TOEFL iBT： 90–100，且各項皆須達 20 分以上 IELTS： 總分 7，且各項皆須達 6.5 若學生在原校就讀之學位課程 完全以英語授課 ，可由交換計畫承辦人／原校出具英語能力證明，以取代英語檢定成績。 英語分級測驗： TOEFL 低於 90–100 或 IELTS 低於 7 者，抵達 UIUC 後須參加 English Placement Test ；校方將依測驗結果建議學生修習適當的英語課程。 選課注意事項 ：UIUC 無法保證學生能修習任何特定課程 ，交換學生應於選課時保持彈性。 其他注意事項 ：擬申請之系所／課程可能另有額外入學條件。 詳細資訊 ： UIUC – Information for Incoming Exchange Students College Restriction: Limited to the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (LAS) , subject to the terms of the exchange agreement. Graduate Students: Graduate students will be admitted to UIUC as undergraduate students , but will be able to take advanced undergraduate and graduate-level coursework at Illinois. English Language Proficiency: Duolingo English Test: Minimum total score of 130 TOEFL iBT: Minimum total score of 90–100, with 20+ in each subscore IELTS: Minimum overall score of 7, with 6.5+ in each module Students enrolled in a degree program taught entirely in English at their home institution may submit verification of English proficiency from their exchange coordinator or home university in lieu of test scores. Verification may be provided on university letterhead. English Placement Test: Students whose TOEFL score is below 90–100 or whose IELTS score is below 7 will need to take the English Placement Test upon arrival. Based on the results, certain English language courses may be recommended. Additional Requirements: The proposed program may have additional admission criteria. More Information: UIUC – Information for Incoming Exchange Students

school_name: 波爾多大學 University of Bordeaux
degrees_raw: 學士班, 碩士班
note_9358: 秋季班：9月-1月 春季班：1月-6月 https://www.u-bordeaux.fr/en/international/come-to-bordeaux/international-students/exchange-programmes?utm_source=chatgpt.com 限學士班及碩士班學生申請，不開放博士班學生申請。 選課限制： 學士班學生不得選修碩士班課程。 校區限制： 學生應依欲修習的學科選擇對應校區，並於單一校區修課，不可跨不同校區選課。 Pessac / Montesquieu Campus： 法律、政治學、經濟學、管理學。 Talence / Peixotto Campus： 理學與科技，包含生物、化學、資訊、數學、物理、地球科學及工程等。 Carreire / Victoire Campus： 健康科學、人文社會科學、教育、心理學、社會學等。 語言要求依領域及授課語言而異： Science and Technology： 法語授課須具備 法語 B1 ；英語授課須具備 英語 B1 。 Health and Human Sciences、Education： 須具備 法語 B2 。 Economics、Management： 英語授課須具備 英語 B2 ；若選課包含法語授課課程，須具備 法語 B2 。 Law & Political Science： 法語授課須具備 法語 B1 ；英語授課須具備 英語 B2 。 IUT 部分課程： 行銷、運輸物流管理、企業與行政管理等課程，法語授課須具備 法語 B1 ；英語授課須具備 英語 B2 。 授課語言： 經濟相關課程所在的 Pessac Campus 有較多英語授課選擇； Talence 及 Carreire Campus 課程則較多以法語授課。 詳細資訊： University of Bordeaux – Exchange Programmes Limited to undergraduate and Master's students; doctoral students are not eligible. Course Restriction: Bachelor's students are not permitted to take Master's-level courses. Campus Restriction: Students must select the appropriate campus according to their intended field of study and take courses at one campus only. Courses across different campuses are not permitted. Pessac / Montesquieu Campus: Law, Political Science, Economics and Management. Talence / Peixotto Campus: Science and Technology, including Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Earth Sciences and Engineering. Carreire / Victoire Campus: Health Sciences, Social Sciences, Education, Psychology, Sociology and related fields. Language requirements vary by field and language of instruction: Science and Technology: B1 French for French-taught courses and/or B1 English for English-taught courses. Health and Human Sciences, Education: B2 French is required. Economics and Management: B2 English for English-taught courses and/or B2 French if the learning agreement includes at least one French-taught course. Law & Political Science: B1 French for French-taught courses and/or B2 English for English-taught courses. Selected IUT Programmes: B1 French for French-taught courses and/or B2 English for English-taught courses, including Marketing, Transport Logistics Management, and Business and Administration Management. Language of Instruction: More English-taught courses are available at the Pessac Campus , particularly in Economics, while courses at the Talence and Carreire campuses are primarily taught in French. More Information: University of Bordeaux – Exchange Programmes

note_9358: 秋季班：9月-1月 春季班：2月-6月 https://www.ens-lyon.fr/formation/catalogue-de-cours/cours-pour-les-etudiants-en-echange?utm_source=chatgpt.com 本校可申請領域：****數學（Mathematics）、資訊科學（Computer Science）、物理（Physics）、化學（Chemistry）、生物（Biology）及地球科學（Earth Sciences 。 語言要求： 依申請領域、修課層級及授課語言而異， 並非所有學生均統一要求法語 B2 。 生物： 學士及碩士課程原則上須具備 法語 B2、英語 B2 。 資訊科學： 英語要求較高，須達 C1 ；學士課程另要求 法語 C1 。 數學： 英語至少 B2 ；學士課程另要求 法語 B2 。 物理： 英語至少 B2 ；法語一般為 B1 。 化學： 英語至少 B2 ；學士課程法語至少 B1 ，碩士課程則未設定統一最低法語門檻。 地球科學／地質學： 英語至少 B2 ；學士課程法語至少 B2 ，碩士課程未設定統一最低法語門檻。 選課： ENS de Lyon 提供交換生專用課程目錄，學生可依 Department、Level、Semester、ECTS 及 Teaching Language 查詢；部分課程仍可能於開學前調整。 詳細資訊： ENS de Lyon – Courses for Exchange Students Eligible Fields under the NTHU Exchange Agreement: Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Earth Sciences. Language Requirements: Requirements vary according to the field of study, academic level, and language of instruction ; therefore, B2 French is not a uniform requirement for all exchange students . Biology: Generally B2 French and B2 English . Computer Science: C1 English ; Bachelor-level courses also require C1 French . Mathematics: Minimum B2 English ; Bachelor-level courses also require B2 French . Physics: Minimum B2 English ; French is generally required at B1 . Chemistry: Minimum B2 English ; Bachelor-level courses require at least B1 French , while no general minimum French level is specified for Master-level courses. Earth Sciences/Geology: Minimum B2 English ; Bachelor-level courses require at least B2 French , while no general minimum French level is specified for Master-level courses. More Information: ENS de Lyon – Courses for Exchange Students

Language Requirement: Requirements vary depending on the host faculty and courses selected. note_9358: 秋季班：9-1月 春季班：1月-6月 https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/global-opportunities/visiting-students/study-in-liverpool/entry-requirements/?utm_source=chatgpt.com 限學士班及碩士班學生申請；博士班學生不開放。 本校可申請領域： 限 Liverpool’s Department of Languages, Cultures and Film 。 **學業成績要求：** GPA 3.0/4.0 或同等成績 。 英語要求： 非英語母語學生須符合 University of Liverpool English Language Requirements ；實際 IELTS、TOEFL 或其他英語檢定要求依所選課程／系所規定而異。 英語檢定效期： 英語檢定須於預計入學日前 2 年內 取得。 短期交換英語證明： 赴 Liverpool 就讀 少於 6 個月 者，可依校方規定提交指定的 English Qualification Form 作為英語能力證明。 畢業年級學生： Liverpool 不建議學生於畢業年赴該校交換 ；若為畢業年交換，建議僅選擇 Semester One ，以避免補考及成績公布時程影響畢業。 博士班： 博士生如欲赴 Liverpool 進行研究，可另行申請 Visiting Postgraduate Research Student 等研究訪問計畫；此類計畫 不屬於一般交換修課計畫 。 詳細資訊： University of Liverpool – Entry Requirements for Visiting and Exchange Students Fact Sheet： University of Liverpool – Fact Sheet Eligibility: Limited to undergraduate and Master’s students; PhD students are not eligible for the regular taught exchange programme. Limited to Liverpool’s Department of Languages, Cultures and Film. Academic Requirement: Minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 or equivalent . English Language Requirement: Non-native English speakers must meet the University of Liverpool’s English language requirements . Specific IELTS, TOEFL or equivalent requirements may vary depending on the programme/department. Validity of English Tests: English language tests must have been taken within two years of the planned start date . Exchange of Less Than Six Months: Students studying at Liverpool for less than six months may submit the University’s designated English Qualification Form as evidence of English proficiency, subject to University requirements. Final-year Students: The University of Liverpool discourages students from studying at Liverpool during their final year unless they attend Semester One only , as resit examinations and the release of results may affect graduation timelines. PhD Students: PhD students interested in conducting research at Liverpool may apply separately for a Visiting Postgraduate Research Student or similar research-visit scheme; this is not part of the regular taught exchange programme . More Information: University of Liverpool – Entry Requirements for Visiting and Exchange Students Fact Sheet： University of Liverpool – Fact Sheet

Eligibility: Open to undergraduate and Master’s students only; PhD students are not eligible. Language Requirement: At least CEFR B2 proficiency in the main language of instruction is recommended. For English, the reference requirements are IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90 or above . Language of Instruction: Courses are mainly taught in German , with some courses offered in English. Availability of English-taught courses varies by faculty and semester. Course Selection: Cross-faculty course booking is generally allowed; however, students should take most courses in their major and minor subject areas . Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences: Cross-level course booking is not permitted. English Department (English Language and Literature): Students who do not major in English Language and Literature at their home university may only take lecture courses offered by the department. Department of Biology: Only students majoring in Biology, Biochemistry or Biomedicine at their home university may take courses in these fields. Block Courses are not open to exchange students. Department of Psychology: Courses are open only to students who major in Psychology at their home university. Faculty of Law: Students wishing to take Law courses must have completed at least four semesters at their home university before beginning their exchange at UZH. More Information: University of Zurich – International Student Exchange

note_9358: 秋季班：9-1月春季班：2月-6月 https://www.unine.ch/mobilite/en/incoming-students/language-requirements/?utm_source=chatgpt.com 授課語言： 主要授課語言為 法語 ；部分碩士課程及 BSc in Economics 三年級部分課程 以英語授課。 法語要求： 修習法語授課課程者須具備至少 CEFR B2 法語能力 。 英語要求： 若 僅修習英語授課課程 ，須具備至少 CEFR B2 英語能力 ；不強制要求法語能力，但校方強烈建議具備一定法語能力，以利日常生活。 語言證明： 接受 IELTS、TOEFL、Cambridge、DELF、DALF 等正式語言檢定，或由原就讀大學 Language Centre 核發之正式語言能力證明；證明須為 4 年內 取得。 修課要求： 每學期須修習 20–30 ECTS ；多數學分須選自交換協議所指定的學習領域，最多約 20% 可跨至其他領域。 詳細資訊： University of Neuchâtel – Language Requirements Language of Instruction: The main language of instruction is French . Some Master’s programmes and part of the third year of the BSc in Economics are taught in English. French Requirement: Students taking courses taught in French must have at least CEFR B2 proficiency in French . English Requirement: Students taking only English-taught courses must have at least CEFR B2 proficiency in English . French is not required in this case but is strongly recommended for daily life. Proof of Language Proficiency: Official language tests such as IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge, DELF or DALF, or an official certificate issued by the home university’s Language Centre, are accepted. Proof must be no more than four years old . Course Load: Students must take 20–30 ECTS per semester . Most credits must be taken in the study field specified in the exchange agreement; up to 20% may be taken in another field . Exchange Duration: Exchange students may study at UniNE for one or two semesters . More Information: University of Neuchâtel – Language Requirements

note_9358: 秋季班: 8-1月 春季班:1-6月 https://liu.se/en/article/application-instructions-arts-and-sciences?utm_source=chatgpt.com 限理工領域學生選填，並限交換至 Linköping University Faculty of Science and Engineering。 主要學科領域： Computer Science、Information Technology、Media Technology and Visualisation；Electrical Engineering、Applied Physics and Computational Sciences；Mechanical Engineering and Design；Industrial Engineering and Logistics；Biology、Chemistry、Biotechnology and Biomedical Engineering。 學士班學生： 建議於 秋季班 交換，因秋季提供較多學士層級課程。大三學生若交換一整學年（秋＋春），可透過秋季修習特定學士課程，取得部分春季碩士課程之修課資格。 碩士班學生： 建議選擇 秋季班或交換一整學年 ，以配合課程進階順序。一般 Master-level 課程須具備相關領域之學士學位及／或至少 3 年大學學習背景，並須符合個別課程先修條件。 先修要求： Faculty of Science and Engineering 強烈建議交換前至少完成 **2 年（120 ECTS）**大學課程。申請 A1N Master-level courses 時，提名／申請時至少須有 120 ECTS （抵達時約 150 ECTS）；A1F 課程則須於申請時至少 180 ECTS （抵達時約 210 ECTS）。 **英語要求：** Faculty of Science and Engineering 目前不要求申請時提交正式英語檢定證明 ，但學生須具備足以修習英語授課課程之良好英語能力。 修課要求： 非歐盟學生每學期須修習至少 30 ECTS ，以符合瑞典居留許可之全日制學習要求。 選課注意： Faculty of Science and Engineering 沒有一般的 Add/Drop period ；申請時即須選妥第一學期各 study period 的課程，校方會審查先修資格及課表衝堂。抵達後原則上僅於特殊情況允許更換課程。 詳細資訊： Linköping University – Faculty of Science and Engineering Exchange Application **居留許可：** 瑞典居留許可及身分驗證方式請依 Swedish Migration Agency 最新規定辦理。 居留許可資訊： Swedish Migration Agency – Higher Education​ Eligible Field: Limited to students in science and engineering-related fields. Exchange is limited to Linköping University’s Faculty of Science and Engineering. Main Subject Areas: Computer Science, Information Technology, Media Technology and Visualisation; Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics and Computational Sciences; Mechanical Engineering and Design; Industrial Engineering and Logistics; Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology and Biomedical Engineering. Bachelor’s Students: An autumn exchange is strongly recommended , as more Bachelor-level courses are available during the autumn semester. Third-year students staying for a full academic year may become eligible for certain Master-level courses in the spring after completing appropriate Bachelor-level courses in the autumn. Master’s Students: An autumn semester or a full academic year is recommended to benefit from course progression. Master-level courses generally require relevant prior university studies and specific prerequisites. Academic Prerequisites: At least two years (120 ECTS) of prior university study is strongly recommended. Specific Master-level courses have additional ECTS and prerequisite requirements. English Language Requirement: The Faculty of Science and Engineering does not currently require an English language certificate with the application. However, students must have a good command of English sufficient to follow their courses. Course Load: Non-EU students must study at least 30 ECTS per semester to meet the full-time study requirement for a Swedish residence permit. Course Changes: There is no regular add/drop period at the Faculty of Science and Engineering. Course selections are reviewed before admission, and changes after arrival are normally approved only in exceptional circumstances. Exchange Duration: Exchange may be for one semester or a full academic year , subject to the applicable NTHU–LiU exchange agreement. More Information: Linköping University – Faculty of Science and Engineering Residence Permit: For residence permit applications and identity/passport verification procedures, please refer to the latest requirements of the Swedish Migration Agency. degrees_raw: 學士班, 碩士班
note_9358: 秋季班：10月1日-3月31日 春季班：4月1日-9月30日 https://fakultaeten.hu-berlin.de/de/mnf/lehre_studium/internationales/aus-dem-ausland/hu-berlin_incoming-fact-sheet_erasmus.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com 限學士班及碩士班學生申請，不開放博士班學生申請。 授課語言： HU Berlin 並非所有系所皆提供英語授課課程，尤其 學士層級之英語授課課程較有限 。選填前請務必確認欲申請系所及當學期實際開設之英語課程。 選課規定： 學士班交換生原則上最多可選修 **2 個系所（departments）**之課程；碩士班交換生原則上自 1 個系所 選課。 特殊語言要求－Faculty of Language, Literature and Humanities / Department of English and American Studies： 學士班：英語至少 CEFR B2 。 碩士班：英語至少 CEFR C1 。 School of Business and Economics： 碩士學程以 英語授課 ，且課程高度著重經濟分析及管理科學之 數量與數學方法 ，因此學生須具備良好的數學背景。最新 2026/27 School of Business and Economics 資料顯示，Bachelor-level exchange students 的語言要求為 German B2 或 English C1 ；Master-level exchange students 為 English C1 。 開放領域： 原則上多數學科領域皆開放交換生，但 Medicine、M.A. Global History、M.A. Global Studies 不開放； Law 及 M.A. Mind and Brain 另可能有申請／選課限制。實際仍須依HU Berlin各系所最新規定辦理。 課程查詢： 請使用 HU Berlin AGNES Online Course Catalogue 查詢最新課程。 **簽證提醒：** 德國學生簽證（包含交換學生）目前透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得交換資格後儘早確認最新簽證規定並準備文件；完成線上文件預審後，系統將提供簽證預約連結，再依通知至德國在台協會辦理生物特徵資料及相關程序。 詳細資訊： Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin 課程查詢： HU Berlin – AGNES Course Catalogue 德國學生簽證： 德國在台協會－學生簽證 Open to undergraduate and Master's students only; PhD students are not eligible to apply. Language of Instruction: Not all departments at HU Berlin offer courses in English, particularly at the undergraduate level . Students should carefully check the courses available in their intended department before applying. Course Selection: Undergraduate exchange students may generally take courses from a maximum of two departments , while graduate exchange students normally select courses from one department . Special Language Requirements – Faculty of Language, Literature and Humanities / Department of English and American Studies: Undergraduate students: minimum CEFR B2 English . Graduate students: minimum CEFR C1 English . School of Business and Economics: Master's programmes are taught in English , and courses have a strong quantitative and mathematical focus. A strong background in Mathematics is therefore essential. For 2026/27, Bachelor-level exchange students require German B2 or English C1 , while Master-level exchange students require English C1 . Available Disciplines: Most disciplines are available to exchange students, except Medicine, M.A. Global History and M.A. Global Studies . Further restrictions may apply to Law and M.A. Mind and Brain . Availability remains subject to the latest departmental requirements. Course Catalogue: Students should use the AGNES Online Course Catalogue to check current course offerings. Visa Reminder: Student visa applications, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through Germany's Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the latest visa requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible. After the online document review has been completed, applicants will receive a link to arrange an appointment for biometrics and the remaining procedures. Course Catalogue: HU Berlin – AGNES Visa Information: German Institute Taipei – Student Visa

conditions: 限交換 1 學期。 限學士班及碩士班學生申請，不開放博士班學生申請。 授課語言： 主要授課語言為 德語 ，但校方持續增加英語授課課程；各學期英語授課課程請依最新課程列表確認。 語言要求： 修習德語或英語授課課程，建議具備該授課語言至少 CEFR B2 程度； 最低入學要求為已完成 CEFR B1 。一般情況下不一定要求提交正式語言能力證明。 特殊語言要求： Law（所有學位層級）、Biochemistry / Chemistry（B.Sc.）： 須提供德語 已完成 B1 或正在修習 B2 之證明。 Biology / Molecular Medicine / Pharmacy（B.Sc.）： 來自海外姊妹校之交換生須提供德語 已完成 B1 或正在修習 B2 之證明。 Human Medicine： 須依校方規定提供相應德語能力證明，且該領域 無英語授課課程 。 選課限制： Biology 僅開放原校主修 Biology 或密切相關領域之海外交換生；Pharmacy 僅開放原校主修 Pharmacy 之學生。Human Medicine 則須原校 Faculty of Medicine 與 Tübingen Faculty of Medicine 另有相關交換協議。 經濟學相關課程： 海外交換生若欲於 Bachelor-level Economics & Business Administration 完全修習英語授課課程 ，須至少已修習 2 門 Mathematics／Statistics／Econometrics 課程，以及 2 門 Business Studies／Economics 課程 。 修課建議： 每學期建議修課量原則上 不超過 30 ECTS 。 德語課程： 校方為交換生提供多種 German as a Foreign Language 課程，包括學期前密集課程及學期間課程。 **簽證提醒：** 德國學生簽證目前主要透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。完成線上文件審查後，系統將提供現場辦理生物特徵資料及繳費之時段，無須另外於一般預約系統預約。建議同學取得交換資格後儘早確認最新簽證規定並準備相關文件。 詳細資訊： University of Tübingen – Application and Preparation for Exchange Students 課程資訊： University of Tübingen – Courses for Exchange Students 德國學生簽證： 德國在台協會－學生簽證

Open to undergraduate and Master's students only; PhD students are not eligible to apply. Language of Instruction: The main language of instruction is German , although an increasing number of courses are offered in English. Students should check the latest list of English-taught courses for each semester. Language Requirements: Students are recommended to have at least CEFR B2 proficiency in the language of instruction (German or English). A completed CEFR B1 level is the minimum requirement for admission . Official proof of language proficiency is not generally required, except for certain subject areas. Special Language Requirements: Law (all study levels), Biochemistry / Chemistry (B.Sc.): Proof of German proficiency at completed B1 or currently studying at B2 level is required. Biology / Molecular Medicine / Pharmacy (B.Sc.): Students from overseas partner universities must provide proof of German proficiency at completed B1 or currently studying at B2 level . Human Medicine: Appropriate proof of German proficiency is required; no English-taught courses are available in this field. Course Restrictions: Biology is available to overseas exchange students only if Biology or a closely related field is their major at their home university. Pharmacy is available only to students majoring in Pharmacy. Human Medicine requires a specific exchange agreement between the respective Faculties of Medicine. Economics: Overseas students wishing to study exclusively in English in the Bachelor’s programme in Economics & Business Administration must have completed at least two courses in Mathematics/Statistics/Econometrics and two courses in Business Studies/Economics . Course Load: A workload of no more than 30 ECTS per semester is recommended. Residence/Visa: Student visa applications are currently submitted primarily through Germany’s Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the latest visa requirements and prepare their documents as early as possible. More Information: University of Tübingen – Application and Preparation

note_9358: 秋季班：10-3月春季班：4月-9月 ** 限理學院、工學院及電機資訊學院之大學部及研究生申請。 機構性質： Leibniz IPHT 位於德國耶拿（Jena），為 非大學型研究機構（non-university research institute） ，是 Leibniz Association 成員，並與 Friedrich Schiller University Jena 維持密切的學術研究合作。 研究特色： 主要從事**光子技術（Photonics）及光學健康科技（Optical Health Technologies）**相關研究，結合物理、化學、生物醫學、工程、資料科學及人工智慧等跨領域技術，應用於健康與醫療、安全、環境及能源等領域。 主要研究領域： 包括 Biomedical Microscopy and Imaging、Multiscale Spectroscopy、Ultrasensitive Detection、Specialty Fiber Optics、Nanoplasmonics，以及 Bioanalytical and Biomedical Chip Systems 。 學生研修方式： Leibniz IPHT 並非一般授課型大學，學生主要透過 專業實習、研究計畫及學位論文研究 等方式參與研究。 學生研究機會： 可進行與學業相關之專業實習，亦可於 Leibniz IPHT 進行 undergraduate thesis、Bachelor’s thesis 或 Master’s thesis 相關研究。相關領域包括 Laser and Optotechnologies、Precision Engineering、Materials Engineering、Biotechnology、Photovoltaics and Semiconductor Technologies、Physical Engineering 及 Computer Engineering 等。 **注意事項：** Leibniz IPHT 為研究機構而非一般大學，因此學生之申請資格、研修期間、研究內容及相關要求，應依本校與 Leibniz IPHT 之合作協議及接收研究團隊之最新規定辦理。 **簽證提醒：** 德國學生簽證目前主要透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得研修資格後儘早確認適用之簽證類別及最新申請規定，並準備相關文件。 官方網站： Leibniz Institute of Photonic Technology (Leibniz IPHT) 學生實習及論文研究： Leibniz IPHT – University Students / Theses Eligible NTHU Students: Open to undergraduate and graduate students from the College of Science, College of Engineering, and College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science. Institution Type: Leibniz IPHT is a non-university research institute located in Jena, Germany. It is a member of the Leibniz Association and maintains close academic and research cooperation with Friedrich Schiller University Jena. Research Focus: Leibniz IPHT specialises in photonics and optical health technologies , combining physics, chemistry, biomedical sciences, engineering, data science and artificial intelligence to develop light-based solutions for health and medicine, safety, the environment and energy. Major Research Areas: Research areas include Biomedical Microscopy and Imaging, Multiscale Spectroscopy, Ultrasensitive Detection, Specialty Fiber Optics, Nanoplasmonics, and Bioanalytical and Biomedical Chip Systems . Study/Research Format: As Leibniz IPHT is a research institute rather than a conventional teaching university, students generally participate through research projects, internships and thesis research rather than regular university coursework. Research Opportunities: Students may undertake study-related internships and research for undergraduate, Bachelor’s or Master’s theses . Relevant fields include Laser and Optotechnologies, Precision Engineering, Materials Engineering, Biotechnology, Photovoltaics and Semiconductor Technologies, Physical Engineering, and Computer Engineering. Important: As Leibniz IPHT is a research institute rather than a conventional university, eligibility, duration of stay, research activities and other requirements are subject to the applicable cooperation agreement with NTHU and the latest requirements of the host research group. Visa Reminder: German student visa applications are currently submitted primarily through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the necessary documents as early as possible after confirming their research placement. Official Website: Leibniz Institute of Photonic Technology (Leibniz IPHT) Student Internships and Thesis Research: Leibniz IPHT – University Students / Theses

note_9358: 秋季班：9-2月 春季班：3月-8月 https://www.uni-goettingen.de/en/507702.html 授課語言： 課程包含 德語及英語授課 ，學生應於申請前確認欲修習課程之授課語言及相關要求。 語言要求： 修習 英語授課課程 ：須具備至少 CEFR B2 英語能力 ；校方提供之參考程度為 TOEFL iBT 79–93 或 IELTS 6.5 。另建議具備 CEFR B1 德語能力 。 修習 德語授課課程 ：須具備至少 CEFR B2 德語能力 。 University of Göttingen 原則上不要求交換生提交正式語言檢定證明 ，由合作大學確認提名學生具備符合要求之語言能力。 德語課程： 校方提供國際學生德語課程，交換生可依自身程度及當學期課程開設情況選修。 **簽證提醒：** 德國學生簽證（包含交換學生）目前透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得交換資格後，儘早確認適用之簽證類別及最新申請規定，並準備相關文件。簽證申請方式及所需文件請以德國在台協會最新公告為準。 詳細資訊： University of Göttingen – Incoming Global Exchange Programme 德國學生簽證： 德國在台協會－學生簽證 Language of Instruction: Courses are offered in German and English . Students should check the language of instruction and relevant requirements for their intended courses before applying. Language Requirements: English-taught courses: Students should have at least CEFR B2 English proficiency . The university provides TOEFL iBT 79–93 or IELTS 6.5 as reference levels. CEFR B1 German is also recommended. German-taught courses: Students should have at least CEFR B2 German proficiency . The University of Göttingen generally does not require exchange students to submit an official language certificate. Partner universities are responsible for ensuring that nominated students have the required language proficiency. German Language Courses: German language courses are available to international students. Exchange students may take these courses according to their language level and course availability. Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange. Open to undergraduate and Master’s students only; PhD students are not eligible to apply. Language of Instruction: Courses at KIT are taught in German and English . The availability of English-taught courses varies by department. Students should check the language of instruction and prerequisites of their intended courses before applying. General Language Requirements: German-taught courses only: Minimum CEFR B1 German . English-taught courses only: Minimum CEFR B2 English . Courses taught in both German and English: Both German B1 and English B2 are required. Special Departmental Language Requirements: Chemistry (CHEM): CEFR C1 German is required for Chemistry courses. Humanities and Social Sciences (GEIST-SOZ): German A2/B1 is mandatory ; students taking English-taught courses must additionally provide proof of English B2 . Most other departments, including Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geo and Environmental Sciences, Chemical and Process Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology, Informatics, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, and Economics and Management, generally follow the German B1 / English B2 requirements above. Language Certificates: Language certificates must have been issued within the five years preceding the application deadline . For Overseas Exchange applicants, the certificate must cover all four language skills: reading, writing, listening and speaking . Online placement tests, certificates of attendance, and certificates without a stated language level are not accepted. German Language Course: Students with insufficient German proficiency are strongly encouraged to participate in the pre-semester German course offered by KIT. Important: Language and course requirements may vary by department. Students should carefully check the latest requirements of their intended KIT department before applying. The latest requirements published by KIT for the relevant application year shall prevail. Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange. Language of Instruction: Courses are primarily taught in German , although some courses are available in English. The number of English-taught courses is particularly limited at the Bachelor’s level. English-taught Courses: Students planning to study exclusively in English must have at least CEFR B2 English proficiency and submit a list of planned courses with their application. Participation in the Intensive German Course is recommended but not compulsory . German-taught Courses: German C1: Participation in the Intensive German Course is optional. German B1 or B2: Participation in the Intensive German Course is optional. German A2 + English B2: Participation in the Intensive German Course is compulsory . Language Certificates: Proof of German or English proficiency must clearly indicate the corresponding CEFR level (A1–C2) . Individual language certificates issued by the home university are generally accepted. Documents not issued in German or English must be accompanied by an appropriate translation. English-taught Courses: Only a limited number of Bachelor-level courses are taught in English. Exchange students may be able to take English-taught MSc courses subject to the relevant academic prerequisites and course availability. Intensive German Course: The course generally starts approximately one month before the lecture period . The current course fee is €250 , and students who meet the attendance requirements and pass the final examination may receive 6 ECTS credits . Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange. More Information: University of Stuttgart – Overseas Exchange Program Visa Information: German Institute Taipei – Student Visa

Language of Instruction: Courses are offered in German and English . Students should check the language of instruction, course level and prerequisites of their intended courses before applying. Language Certificate: Exchange students are required to submit a Language Certificate as part of their exchange application. German Language Course: TUHH offers an approximately two-week Intensive German Language Course before the Winter Semester . The course is free of charge for exchange students from partner institutions and may be worth 4 ECTS . Please note that participation in this course cannot be used as proof of the B1 German proficiency required for admission to exchange studies . The intensive course is currently not offered before the Summer Semester. Regular German Courses: Exchange students may also take German as a Foreign Language courses during the semester. Enrolment and Semester Fee: Exchange students must complete enrolment after arrival and pay the applicable semester fee , which covers student services and the public transport semester ticket, among other benefits. Health Insurance: Students must provide proof of valid health insurance that meets German requirements when enrolling at TUHH. Travel health insurance is not accepted as a substitute for student health insurance. Important: Examination periods may extend well beyond the lecture period. Students should check their examination dates before booking their return flights. Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange. Doctoral students are not eligible to apply. Language of Instruction: The main language of instruction at TU Darmstadt is German , although a growing number of courses for advanced Bachelor’s and Master’s students are offered in English . Language Requirements for Students from Non-European Partner Universities: English-taught courses: Minimum CEFR B2 English . German-taught courses: Minimum CEFR B2 German . Even when studying entirely in English, students are strongly encouraged to have at least basic German (A1–A2) for everyday life in Germany. Proof of Language Proficiency: Accepted proof may include TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge certificates, a letter from a language instructor at the home university, or a transcript of records demonstrating the required level. Proof should ideally be no more than two years old . English native speakers and students studying in English or at an English-language institution generally do not need to provide proof of English proficiency. German Language Courses: TU Darmstadt offers free intensive German language courses before the beginning of the semester , usually in March or September. Participation is recommended even for students planning to study primarily in English. Course Load: TU Darmstadt uses the ECTS system. A standard workload is approximately 30 ECTS per semester / 60 ECTS per academic year . Semester Fee: Exchange students are required to pay the applicable semester fee , which is adjusted each semester. Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange. experience_posts.title: 清大赴上海交通大學交換心得報告
experience_posts.excerpt: 1 一學期體驗新的學習方式 感受不同環境下的生活 110 學年度上學期 上海交通大學交換 工學院學士班李羿均 ---PAGE--- 2 一、研修目的 出國交換是上大學給自己的一個目標 ， 透過出國交換增進自我視野 ， 離開原本 的舒適圈，在不同的生活環境下自我成長，並且體驗不同環境的教學方式，和大陸 的學生及教授進行知識的交流。 上海交通大學是中國大陸前五名的高校之一 ， 同時也是世界前百強大學 ， 尤其 在理工方面特別出名 。 而上海交通大學在電化學方面的研究非常先進 ， 甚至成立了 上海電化學能源器件工程技術研究中心 ， 是電池研究的先驅 。透過這次的研修更精 進自己對電化學相關的知識。 二、研修心得 這次出國主要是為了交換一學期的交流 ， 在上海交通大學修習課程一個學期。 這學期我主要的修習課程是包含了原本必修課程 （機械性質、分析化學、分析化學 實驗二）以及其他與電化學專題相關的課

experience_posts.excerpt: 目錄 : 事前準備 護照 基本上護照只會在從台灣入境到大陸會使用到，但是請務 必在大陸保管好，沒有護照也回不了台灣。 台胞證 這個在大陸就相當於我們的身分證，不管去景區、學校、 辦理業務都需要使用到這張卡，說是最頻繁使用的證件也 不為過。 保險 需在搭機前先辦理完成，我自己是買國泰世華的旅平險， 只要理賠金額不要太過低基本上選哪家保險都行。 銀行帳戶 強烈建議在台灣就先辦富邦華一銀行的戶頭，在這裡可以 直接先存一些人民幣進去，免得在隔離結束後會面臨需要 付款卻無銀行卡可用的窘境。 電信 入境前先有一個門號能收簡訊是必要的，在抵達通關時會 需要你填寫當地親友的住址以及手機門號，同時也會要一 個你在當地的手機號碼，所以請記得先申請一個暫時用的 手機號預備。 這裡有三種方法，一種是使用微信上的「易博通」虛擬門 號，優點是不需要換 SIM 卡便可直接接收簡訊，但無法 接通電話以及部分平台無法認證該

experience_posts.excerpt: 國立清華大學赴大陸港澳地區交換生 成果報告書 學生姓名 林妍玲 學生系所 特殊教育學系 研修地區 中國大陸杭州市 研修大學 浙江大學 研修系所 教育學院 出國日期 2026 年 02 月 25 日 回國日期 2026 年 07 月 02 日 報告日期 2026 年 07 月 30 日 修讀學分總數 10 學分 ---PAGE--- 1 走出舒適圈，在浙江大學遇見更寬廣的自己 ---PAGE--- 2 摘要 本報告記錄了筆者於 2026 年春夏學期前往中國浙江大學進行半年交流學習的 完整歷程。報告內容涵蓋了出國研修之核心目的、入境與宿舍入住生活適應、 當地行動服務與銀行開戶流程、跨學制與跨領域之選課體驗、校園飲食與交通 網絡、自主旅行與地方文化探索，以及個人的學習成長總結與給予未來交換生 的建議。透過這次走出舒適圈的經驗，筆者不僅在學術與跨領域學習上獲益良 多，更顯著提升了獨立解決問題與面對

note_9358: 1. An overall band of 6.5 in IELTS Academic Module (within 2 years after the test date) A score of 93 in the TOEFL internet-based test, or 583 in the paper-based test (prior to July 2017) or an overall score of 70 in the revised TOEFL Paper-delivered Test (October 2017 onwards) (within 2 years after the test date). 2. Programmes / courses offered by the following Faculties are NOT opened to exchange students: Faculty of Dentistry Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine BSc (Exercise and Health) Programme Most final year project courses provided by all faculties *Facts from 2026 Fall: University Housing Availability: Due to a significant increase in demand, we are unable to guarantee university housing to all incoming exchange students. This shortage is particularly acute during Semester 1 (September – December). Recommendation: Housing pressure is greatly reduced during Semester 2 (January – May), and we recommend trying to redirect some students to come during this period if possible. Faculty of Business and Economics (FBE) Course Enrolment: Courses offered by FBE have become increasingly competitive. No Guarantees: Enrolment in any specific FBE course cannot be guaranteed. Course Load: It is unlikely that students will be able to take a full course load focused entirely on a single discipline within this Faculty. Academic Flexibility & Alternative Options: We strongly encourage students to be flexible with their course planning and to have backup plans ready. Furthermore, we highly recommend that students consider applying to other faculties where possible. Common Core (CC) Courses: We highly recommend that exchange students consider enrolling in CC courses. These interdisciplinary courses cover a wide range of global and local topics. Students may take up to two CC courses from a selective menu, with each course chosen from a different Area of Inquiry: 'Scientific and Technological Literacy', 'Humanities', 'Global Issues' and 'China: Culture, State and Society'. They are an excellent way for students to earn credits while exploring subjects outside their primary major, and they often provide more flexible enrolment opportunities.
